title: 01-route
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity visual DESIGN VARIANT of the attached Russian conference website mockup, as a beautiful finished webpage shown edge to edge, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no board, no explanation labels. The attachment is a reference for the brand palette, the exact Russian content, expressive composition and use of human photography. Redesign the composition according to the variant below, not a literal copy. Desktop webpage width around 1600px; show an entire first screen and a substantial following storytelling section below, overall image about 1600x1600. Typography is elegant modern Cyrillic grotesk, medium weight, clear hierarchy, restrained negative tracking. Every word of the headline must be visible and readable, with equal-sized wording and no photo covering letters. All headings and labels use normal sentence case, never ALL CAPS; the АСП logo and acronyms are exceptions. Flat white/very pale lavender backgrounds, ink dark violet #292338, accent violet #7954D4, clean edges. Absolutely NO graph paper, grid background, notebook lines, ruled paper, classroom props, cheesy student costume, background dots, generic icon tiles, gradient text, glassmorphism, meaningless floating elements. Clean spacious alignment, purposeful expressive editorial layout. Hero facts: 21 ноября 2026, онлайн, участие бесплатно. Exact h1 text: «Как превратить знания из вуза в первую практику». Exact supporting copy: «Конференция для студентов и выпускников: где работать, какой метод выбрать и как найти первых клиентов». Exact main button text: «Зарегистрироваться бесплатно». Gift copy: «Карта психологических подходов — сразу после регистрации». Header small logo «АСП», links «Для кого», «Программа», «Спикеры», secondary action «Регистрация». Use authentic editorial-looking photos of adults; these are illustrative people, not named speakers. Keep all controls and body text legible at desktop scale. Do not add invented metrics, endorsements or professional claims. Polish to the standard of an Osmo/independent creative studio site, with real compositional storytelling instead of a standard template.
VARIANT 1: «Из вопросов — в маршрут». Inspired by reference image 1, but completely REMOVE its graph-paper background and replace it with uninterrupted warm white. Compose the first 62% of the image as an asymmetric editorial layout: large fully readable headline in three lines occupies the upper left 65%; below are the short body, date and prominent violet registration button. On the right a beautifully photographed cut-out young adult woman, age about 26, wearing a simple black sweater, confident curious expression, carrying no notebook, overlaps the top edge of a large dark-violet softly rectangular photographic field. Her portrait is cropped at the waist. Integrate only two purposeful little lavender question slips near the lower portrait reading «Какой метод?» and «Первый клиент?». One fine violet continuous path begins at a subtle underline under «знания из вуза», crosses the clean gap between type and portrait without crossing any letters, and leads gently into the next section. One tiny handwritten annotation near CTA reads «Начнём с ориентиров». The lower 38% of the image transitions with no boxed section border into an editorial audience block on the same white ground: left large heading «Знаю много. С чего начать?» and small supporting text «Отметьте вопросы, которые сейчас важны вам». On the right three clean generous checklist rows with fine rules and round unfilled check controls. Text of rows: «Страшно начинать консультировать», «Хочу выбрать подходящий метод», «Не знаю, где искать первых клиентов». The violet path ends at the first checkbox, making one connected story. Include a modest outlined link «Найти свой трек». Sparse handwritten ink only in two places, professional clean look, no excessive stickers. The composition must feel human, confident and premium, never school-themed.
purpose: Composition exploration only. No implementation selected.
